how: transcript_full.jsonl of the root of an interactive session in the e2e sandbox against the fake model (2026-11-09), each case its own session whose root called invoke_subagent (TypeName self, Role Background helper) with the subagent's model call held: `kill`, the root then calling manage_subagents kill with its conversation id and answering "Killed it.", nothing following in 8 s; `killAll`, manage_task list ("No background tasks are currently running.") then manage_subagents kill_all; `error`, the subagent's model refusing with a 400, which woke the root; `escape`, Escape pressed while the root's model call after the launch was held, then the subagent let go: its idle message came only with the next prompt, `Ping now`, ahead of it; `exit`, /quit with the subagent running: nothing after the root's last words.
